name: Attack D: delayed request and argument-exact approval
narrative: Deleting requires human approval. The first attempt is queued and nobody decides, so it times out and is denied with nothing deleted. The second attempt is approved by a reviewer and executes exactly once. The third attempt uses a different path under the same tool and task; the earlier grant does not match its argument digest, so it queues its own review and is denied. Approval is argument-exact and single-use.

steps.note: Queued for review, nobody decides, the bounded wait elapses and the call is denied. The upstream delete counter stays at zero. The wire decision is a denial carrying AD-A005; the pending record is asserted separately from the database.
A reviewer approves these exact canonical arguments. The grant is consumed once and the file is deleted.
Different path, so a different canonical args digest. The consumed grant for demo.txt authorizes nothing here.
